end.summary:
Asha practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya identified a rocket as having a cylinder and cone, and a ball as a sphere.
They described a cylinder as round and without box-like corners.
They first thought a turned cone might change shape name, then corrected this and said it remains a cone.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming 3D shapes in familiar objects, especially a rocket, ball and candle. They used object features such as round sides, corners and a pointed tip to explain their answers. There was a mix-up about whether turning a cone changes its name; they corrected it later by saying it remains a cone whether upside down or upright. At home, ask them to find and name one cylinder, cone, sphere, cube or cuboid in three toys or household objects.
